facts.fact: The gazetted regulations refer to the National Cybersecurity Committee established under section 3 of the Cybersecurity and Cybercrime Act 2021, which may designate critical information infrastructure.

MUS.note: Regulations set the designation mechanism for five sectors; no system is stated as designated.

facts.fact: The Government Gazette publishes the Critical Information Infrastructure Designation Regulations 2026 under the Cybersecurity and Cybercrime Act 2021, in operation from 1 June 2026.
